'If Hemorrhage Bore has an aim counter, it has "When this hits a hero, destroy a card in their arsenal."' Ranger Action - Arrow Attack (Dynasty). Yellow printing - identical printed text to .drafts/hemorrhage_bore_blue.json / .drafts/hemorrhage_bore_red.json, which this file copies; every handler claim below was re-verified against source this session.

DEVIATION FROM THE TRIAGE LIST, deliberate: triage named DESTROY_ARSENAL, but its handler destroys EVERY card in the arsenal (effect_types.py:2994-3008 loops all of player.arsenal.cards) with no choice - wrong for 'destroy A card', and it contradicts official_release_notes 1 ('if the hero hit has two or more cards in their arsenal, you choose which one'). Instead the destroy-one-with-choice behaviour is composed from verified primitives: LOOK_AT zone ARSENAL player OPPONENT amount ALL stores the whole arsenal as a list (zone map includes ARSENAL, effect_types.py:3390); SELECT_FROM_REF mode ANY min 1 max 1 asks the controller to pick exactly one at RESOLUTION time (release note 1's timing), degrades to a no-op when the arsenal is empty (empty pool -> loop never runs -> chosen=[]), and with min 1 the choice is mandatory whenever a card exists; DESTROY_REF destroys the picked card(s) via canonical destroy() (effect_types.py:3417-3428).

CONDITIONS are ability-level, AND-gated in run_ability (interpreter.py:54-55) before any effect runs:
- COUNTER_GTE reads counter_type (or counter/type) and min (or amount) (condition_types.py:998-1030) and tests THIS card's own counters tally - the ability source IS Hemorrhage Bore, so 'Hemorrhage Bore has an aim counter' is exactly card.counters['aim'] >= 1. The card-level tally is authoritative because it travels with the card through arsenal -> combat chain (the handler's own comment names precisely this staleness case for the player-level fallback dict). Spelling 'aim' matches shipped azl/sedation_shot_blue.json, azl/infecting_shot_blue.json, dyn/blessing_of_focus_*.json.
- ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO (condition_types.py:1960) gates 'hits a hero' - false when the attack was declared at a permanent or ally.

Conditions gate at resolution, so the trigger queues on every hit and fizzles harmlessly without an aim counter; consequently multiple aim counters still yield ONE instance per hit (official_release_notes 2) by construction - no extra authoring needed.

No printed keywords. Yellow printing; siblings differ only in colour.
